query: Upgrade this project to Cypress v14.
expected_behavior: Identifies the target major as v14 and follows the v14 path; confirms cypress is on the 13.x prerequisite.
Flags Node 16 (from .nvmrc) as an install blocker (minimum supported is 18).
Flags React 17 as below the component-testing minimum of 18.0.0.
Flags webpack-dev-server 3 as unsupported (v5 ships by default).
Flags framework: 'create-react-app' as no longer supported and recommends a real bundler with framework: 'react'.
Flags the removed config options experimentalSkipDomainInjection and experimentalFetchPolyfill.
Flags experimentalJustInTimeCompile as removed (justInTimeCompile is the default).
Identifies the before:browser:launch handler that treats the second argument as an array and notes the signature change.
Flags the two-origin cy.visit interaction without cy.origin() and recommends wrapping the second-origin interaction in cy.origin().
Flags resourceType on cy.intercept as deprecated.
Flags the about:blank win.fetch() call as unsupported and recommends cy.request() or visiting first.
Recommends replacing the open-ct / run-ct scripts with cypress open --component / cypress run --component.
Halts before installing because of the Node install blocker rather than silently proceeding.
